It requires careful implementation of several steps and understanding of the underlying physical chemistry, but it is not a novel algorithm or deep research-grade derivation. Falls in the 'established but non-trivial' category (3).
rationale.execution: The pipeline includes (1) obtaining and transforming force-field data, (2) constructing a custom locally dense basis set with exponent extrapolation, (3) running SCF and MP2 EFG calculations in DALTON (or equivalent), (4) performing harmonic vibrational analysis, and (5) combining raw and corrected values. The need to interface with a specific quantum-chemistry package, build custom basis sets, and chain several computational steps makes it a fragile multi-tool orchestration (4).
